config.population: training_eligible rows with an observed outcome (E[points | returned]; P(returns) is the availability model's question)

warehouse.sha256: not computed — multi-GB store; identified by path, size, mtime and table facts

notes: xfp_* columns are nflverse ffopportunity expected points, a third-party fitted model. Its documentation (https://ffopportunity.ffverse.com/, read 2026-09-06) says it "uses xgboost and tidymodels trained on public nflverse data from 2006-2020"; the model version behind each warehouse row is not recorded. That window overlaps feature seasons 2018-2020 at play level, so arms using them are labelled exploratory and are not point-in-time evidence.
opp_* columns are raw per-game counts from the feature season only.
